record.paper: Ramsey and Turán numbers of sparse hypergraphs

dossier_meta.paper: Ramsey and Turán numbers of sparse hypergraphs
dossier_meta.statement_text: There is a constant $c_{k}>0$ such that for every $k$-uniform $k$-partite hypergraph $H$, $\mathrm{ex}(n,H)\leq O_{H}\left(n^{k-\frac{c_{k}}{d_{\mathsf{max}}(H)}}\right).$
dossier_meta.context_text: Theorem 1.4 gives $\Omega_{k}(n^{k-C_{k}/d_{1}(H)})\leq\operatorname{ex}(n,H)\leq O_{H}(n^{k-c_{k}/d_{1}(H)^{k-1}})$. The complete $k$-partite hypergraph $K^{(k)}_{d,\ldots,d}$ shows the upper bound is tight in $d_{1}$, while the bipartite hedgehog $H_{d}^{(k)}$ shows the lower bound is tight in $d_{1}$. This gap motivates replacing $d_{1}(H)$ by the finer quantity $d_{\mathsf{max}}(H)=\max_{1\leq i<k}d_{i}(H)$, and Conjecture 6.2 asserts that the Turán exponent is controlled by $d_{\mathsf{max}}(H)$.
